svg.title: Jogge di Balla
svg.desc: Food and drink orders move from service to the kitchen and bar. Jogge di Balla A club website became the system behind an event. Co-founder, vice president and developer. From membership management to orders, live photos and the screens around the venue. Service Kitchen Food orders Bar Drinks Run the club Members, permissions and attendance. Run the event Orders and a till for service, kitchen and bar. Share the night Moderated photos and streaming overlays.
